snippet.title: Evolvania - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at Evolvania in this announcement trailer.
Venture into a colossal creature by merging with the environment and enemies. Evolve and acquire new powers. Evolvania is an hand-drawn metroidvania in which you can play a breathtaking adventure or create your own with a special level editor.

Evolvania will be available on PC via Steam.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560430/Evolvania/
